name: Awarding Laptops To Meritorious Students Of Meghalaya
benefit: - The eligible student will be awarded a laptop.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must have studied in the State of Meghalaya; or the applicant should be a resident of Meghalaya who studied outside the State. 1. The applicant must have topped in the respective Annual School Board Examinations in a particular year. 1. The applicant must have passed the examinations conducted only by: - Meghalaya Board of School Education (MBOSE); - Council for the Indian School Certificate Examinations (CISCE); - Central Board for School Education (CBSE). 1. The applicant must have appeared in Class X or Class XII Annual Board Examinations of the above-mentioned Boards/Council. 1. The applicant of Class X of CBSE Board shall be selected as per [Section 3 II (a)](https://ditmeghalaya.gov.in/pdf/9.Policy%20for%20awarding%20Laptops%20to%20meritorious%20students%20of%20the%20State%20of%20Meghalaya.pdf).1. For Class XII, the applicant should have topped in any stream, namely Arts, Commerce or Science. > **Subject-Specific Eligibility (MBOSE Only):** 1. For Class X (MBOSE), the applicant who is a subject topper in Mathematics, Science or Computer Application shall also be eligible for the award. 1. For Class XII (MBOSE), the applicant who is a subject topper in Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Computer Application or Biology shall also be eligible for the award. 1. The applicant whose name appears as an MBOSE top ranker as well as a subject topper (in one or more subjects) shall be eligible for only one award in a particular year. 1. However, in recognition of such achievement, the applicant shall be awarded a Laptop of configuration higher than those of other awardees.
